findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_money_owed, check_train_delay, get_claim_instructions, scan_for_claims · Private data: find_money_owed, check_train_delay, check_flight_compensation, check_tfl_journeys, get_claim_instructions, scan_for_claims, check_commute, update_claim_status, add_train_journey, add_flight, add_parking_fine, delete_my_data · Public sink: get_claim_instructions · Destructive: delete_my_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_money_owed, check_train_delay, get_claim_instructions, scan_for_claims · Private data: find_money_owed, check_train_delay, check_flight_compensation, check_tfl_journeys, get_claim_instructions, scan_for_claims, check_commute, update_claim_status, add_train_journey, add_flight, add_parking_fine, delete_my_data · Public sink: get_claim_instructions · Destructive: delete_my_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
